How Do You Safely Dose Cannabis Edibles for Recreational and Wellness Use?

Safe dosing of cannabis edibles involves understanding potency and individual tolerance levels. Consumers are advised to start with a small amount—often around 5-10mg of THC—and wait for effects before consuming more.

This approach allows individuals to determine their comfort levels without the risk of overwhelming effects. Additionally, consulting with knowledgeable dispensary staff can enhance dosing strategies, providing personalized advice based on experience and desired effects.
